name: notion-mcp-server
description: Token-auth Notion MCP server: pages, databases, blocks, comments, files and templates behind two context-efficient tools, with batched writes and markdown round-trip.

settings.name: Notion token
settings.description: Personal Access Token (ntn_...) or Internal Integration Secret. Create one at https://app.notion.com/developers/tokens

settings.name: Default parent page ID (optional)
settings.description: Used by create_page / create_database when no parent is given. Leave empty to always pass a parent explicitly.
